# Advanced Modelling for Structured Data

> Decide when pretrained models, stacked ensembles and decision-aware pipelines earn their place, measured against tuned baselines and under shift. SDAIA Academy course DS-404, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 19,245 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Pretrained models for tables](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/slides/day1.md): A tuned baseline, a pretrained model and the curve between them; sessions: Tuned boosted trees first, In-context learning on tables, Learning curves decide, Reading a leaderboard claim; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/slides/day1.html; about 5,227 tokens
- [Day 2: Forecasting with pretrained models](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/slides/day2.md): Zero-shot forecasts on 400 series, by group, with holidays and stacking; sessions: Zero-shot against a benchmark floor, Where zero-shot loses, Holidays that move, Ensembles worth their cost; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/slides/day2.html; about 4,624 tokens
- [Day 3: From forecast to order](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/slides/day3.md): Quantiles into orders, trucks and regret; sessions: Asymmetric costs, Optimising under capacity, Scoring by regret, Uncertainty in the plan; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/slides/day3.html; about 4,130 tokens
- [Day 4: Shift and adoption](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/slides/day4.md): Shift found, validated and corrected, then the adoption decision; sessions: Detecting shift, Validating under shift, Correcting for shift, Adoption conditions; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/slides/day4.html; about 3,785 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone project presentations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/slides/capstone.md): An evaluation protocol and an adoption decision, defended before two assessors; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/slides/capstone.html; about 910 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: A tuned baseline under a budget](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D1_1_tune_boosted_tree.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: A pretrained model on the same folds](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D1_2_run_pretrained_tabular.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Learning curves with intervals](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D1_3_plot_both_across.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Check a leaderboard claim](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D1_4_check_claim_unequal.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Zero-shot against the supplied backtests](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D2_1_score_zero_shot.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Where the benchmark wins](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D2_2_find_series_groups.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Ramadan and Eid as covariates](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D2_3_add_ramadan_eid.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Stacking on rolling-origin windows](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D2_4_stack_forecasters_rolling.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Newsvendor quantities](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D3_1_compute_newsvendor_quantities.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Orders and trucks for one depot week](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D3_2_solve_order_truck.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Regret against error](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D3_3_rank_three_forecasters.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Stress-test the plan](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D3_4_stress_test_plan.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Adversarial validation](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D4_1_run_adversarial_validation.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Four schemes against deployed error](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D4_2_compare_random_grouped.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Weighted conformal intervals](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D4_3_apply_weighted_conformal.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: Licence, cost and residency](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-404/labs/D4_4_complete_licence_cost.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
